reader: Commercial lines producer or account manager at an agency that writes contractors and general contractors, choosing which compliance platform to recommend or work in
questions: What is the best platform for insurance brokers to collaborate with general contractors on COI compliance?
How do COI compliance platforms let brokers work with general contractors?
notes: Buyer's guide ramp item 6 (P24). Best-for format, not a score. Vendor facts from each vendor's own page checked Nov 25, 2026: TrustLayer brokers and partners page plus its 7 ways broker article; illumend broker partner page; Billy brokers and carriers page; Certificial Agent Assist and agents pages; Jones llms.txt. None of the broker program pages states a fee or revenue share, or says brokers get their own login or see the client's requirements, so the post says that plainly. Forsured facts limited to the homepage (shared GC and broker resolution workflow; broker sees the requirement, the document and the project). The one thing no competing page has: the split between platforms a broker resells or refers to clients and platforms where the broker works inside the general contractor's project, plus five questions to tell them apart.
